original_prompt:
MANDATORY CAMERA AND POSE OVERRIDE: final subject must be strictly FRONT-FACING and EYE-LEVEL, head absolutely UPRIGHT with ZERO lateral tilt, ZERO turn, ZERO upward or downward pitch. Passport-photo head alignment: both pupils on the exact same horizontal line, nose bridge and chin aligned on a vertical centerline above sternum, shoulders level. Face and eyes look directly straight into lens. DO NOT COPY THE HEAD TILT, BODY LEAN OR CAMERA ANGLE FROM THE REFERENCE PORTRAIT. It supplies identity and aesthetic only. This requirement has priority over the reference pose. Neutral relaxed closed lips, no coy pose. Camera optical axis is horizontal at eye level, long-lens minimal perspective; entire standing body visible.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Make a completely NEW, freshly synthesized full-length studio character photograph from scratch, not an edit, extension, restoration or repaint of a full-body picture. Input image is ONLY the approved close-up identity and visual-style reference: faithfully recreate the same adult woman's recognizable face, eye shape and color, hair, complexion, age, and delicate clean high-key photographic aesthetic. It is NOT a canvas to extend. Build the entire body, pose, clothing and image freshly in one coherent native render.
ANATOMY: approximately 7 heads tall, with a visibly proportionate, sufficiently large adult head. Crown-to-chin skull length about ONE SEVENTH (14.3%) of crown-to-sole body height. Do not shrink her head to make her seem tall. Natural slender elegant physique, graceful shoulders with width about 2.1–2.3 head WIDTHS, natural neck, properly proportioned ribcage and pelvis, balanced torso length, crotch slightly below halfway down total height, knees at natural height, anatomically convincing arms and hands. She looks poised and slender without stretched legs, a compressed torso, tiny head, giant head, or heavy broad shoulders. Pose: perfectly front-facing relaxed upright stance, head level, hands relaxed at sides, feet slightly apart.
OUTFIT: white short-sleeve T-shirt under black sleeveless knit vest, beige straight-leg trousers, black loafers. Match the reference's visible garment color and texture exactly; preserve any visible jewelry and glasses. Clothing fits anatomically with fine realistic seams, folds and weave. No invented styling.
QUALITY AND STYLE: match the reference's crisp delicate face detail, individual eyelashes, luminous real skin texture, fine hair strands and clean true-color fabric. Refined photoreal studio portrait, not illustration, not a 3D render, not gritty documentary, not beauty-filter waxy skin. Native high-resolution generation requested 2048x3072 portrait, maximum fine detail across face and clothes, sharply resolved in-focus from head to shoes. Do not upscale, resample, denoise or reprocess an old image. No low-resolution haze, painterly smoothing, blur, sharpening halos, jpeg artifacts or grain.
COMPOSITION: one person only on pure white seamless background, soft bright neutral studio light, no tint, faint floor contact shadow. Eye-level long-lens front view, no camera tilt and no perspective elongation. Entire crown and soles visible, body fills about 90% of vertical canvas with narrow comfortable white margins. No collage, text, labels or anatomy ruler.
